description: Bounded DNS and TLS certificate audit for a single PUBLIC business hostname. Checks public IPs, TLS validity, TLS version and days until certificate expiry. No page scraping, no user-provided URLs, no private IP probing. $0.05 USDC on Base via x402. Input example: example.com. Performs bounded public DNS resolution and one pinned TLS handshake on port 443, no HTTP request. Reports tls_valid, public IPs and certificate details; not a vulnerability scan or trust certification.

domain.description: Public DNS hostname, for example example.com; no URL, IP, credentials or private host.

name: domain_dns_tls_audit
title: Public domain DNS and TLS audit
